config.anchor: the exact matched T-PLE baseline is trained first, restored at its best validation epoch, frozen, and kept in evaluation mode
config.hypothesis: A frozen, parameter-matched T-PLE predictor can be safely extended by a zero-start neural residual trained on Q-minus-T and midrank-minus-T token charts.
config.pilot_gate: nonnegative validation gain versus the internal frozen anchor in all 11 cells, strict wins in at least 6/11, positive mean validation gain, and nonnegative mean descriptive test gain
config.residual_initialization: a scalar residual gate is exactly zero
config.safe_selection: epoch zero is the frozen anchor and remains eligible for validation early stopping
